content.value_statement: Reinforcement learning projects need correct algorithms, environments, callbacks, and evaluation workflows. This skill guides Stable Baselines3 setup, training, custom Gymnasium environments, vectorized execution, and model evaluation.
actual_capabilities: Select SB3 algorithms for discrete, continuous, and goal-conditioned RL tasks.
Draft training workflows with callbacks, checkpointing, evaluation, and TensorBoard logging patterns.
Design Gymnasium custom environments with valid spaces, reset methods, step methods, and render modes.
Use vectorized environments, normalization, and multiprocessing guidance for faster training.
Evaluate trained agents with reward statistics, model comparison, and optional video recording.
limitations: It does not train agents by itself; users must run generated Python code locally.
It assumes Stable Baselines3, Gymnasium, PyTorch, and optional extras are installed.
It provides templates, not guaranteed hyperparameters for every environment.
It does not verify safety or correctness of third-party Gymnasium environments.

use_cases.title: Prototype an RL Baseline
use_cases.description: Create an initial SB3 training workflow with algorithm choice, callbacks, checkpoints, and evaluation metrics.

use_cases.title: Design a Custom Environment
use_cases.description: Plan a Gymnasium environment with correct spaces, reset behavior, step returns, rendering, and validation.

use_cases.title: Teach Practical Reinforcement Learning
use_cases.description: Explain SB3 workflows, algorithm tradeoffs, vectorized environments, and common training issues for learners.

prompt_templates.title: Plan My First Agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me train a PPO agent on CartPole-v1. Explain the environment setup, callbacks, evaluation plan, and expected output files.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Environment Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Gymnasium environment for my task. Define observations, actions, rewards, termination rules, rendering, and validation steps for SB3.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Training Throughput
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my SB3 training setup and suggest vectorized environment, normalization, callback, and logging changes for faster reliable experiments.

prompt_templates.title: Compare RL Algorithms
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an experiment plan comparing PPO, SAC, TD3, and DQN for my environment. Include metrics, seeds, evaluation frequency, and failure checks.

output_examples.input: I need a PPO baseline for CartPole with periodic evaluation.
output: A recommended PPO workflow with training and evaluation environments.
Callback guidance for best-model saving, checkpoints, and TensorBoard logs.
Evaluation steps using deterministic actions and repeated episodes.

output_examples.input: I want a custom grid environment for SB3.
output: A design checklist for action space, observation space, reward logic, and termination conditions.
Validation guidance using SB3 environment checks before training.
Rendering and debugging notes for human and array-based views.

output_examples.input: My off-policy training is slow with multiple environments.
output: A review of vectorized environment tradeoffs and multiprocessing overhead.
Guidance on gradient steps, replay buffer size, and evaluation frequency.
A measurement plan to compare wall-clock speed and sample efficiency.

best_practices: Validate custom environments with check_env before training begins.
Use evaluation callbacks and checkpointing so long training runs can be compared and resumed.
Record seeds, hyperparameters, wrappers, and normalization statistics with each experiment.
anti_patterns: Do not skip environment validation when reward logic or observation shapes change.
Do not compare agents without using the same evaluation episodes and deterministic setting.
Do not use many subprocess environments for lightweight tasks without measuring overhead.

faq.question: What Stable Baselines3 algorithms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers PPO, A2C, SAC, TD3, DDPG, DQN, HER usage patterns, and selection guidance for common action spaces.

faq.question: Can it create a custom Gymnasium environment?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide environment structure, spaces, reset and step methods, rendering, registration, and validation.

faq.question: Does it run training automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and templates. The user runs training code in a local Python environment.

faq.question: Can it help evaluate trained agents?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes evaluation patterns, repeated episodes, deterministic action selection, model comparison, and optional video recording.

faq.question: Does it support vectorized environments?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains DummyVecEnv, SubprocVecEnv, normalization, API differences, and multiprocessing tradeoffs.

faq.question: Is this skill only for experts?
faq.answer: No. It supports beginner setup, intermediate debugging, and advanced experiment design for reinforcement learning projects.
